Author the document with the current coding agent by default. Do not run `analyze` unless the user explicitly asks to send the diff to another model provider. `pnpm dlx @coldtea/pr-lens-cli@0.4.0 analyze --base <ref>` sends repository metadata, changed-file names and up to 400 KB of the raw diff to Gemini, OpenAI or the configured `/chat/completions` endpoint using the user's key.
